name: TAD16K
description: A large-scale dataset and evaluation suite for perception tasks in autonomous driving (e.g., detection/segmentation across diverse driving scenarios).
evaluation_method: mean Average Precision (mAP) for detection and Intersection-over-Union (IoU) / mean IoU for segmentation (task-dependent)
notes: Large-scale driving scenarios with diverse conditions and class imbalance; possible overlap/domain similarity with other driving datasets; non-LLM benchmark; task-dependent metrics (detection vs segmentation).
